highlightBadges.title: Highlight badges
highlightBadges.description: Maps a highlight name to badge colors. The colors are exposed as the CSS variables --badge-background-color and --badge-text-color on the highlight wrapper and text elements.

badgeLabel.title: Badge label
badgeLabel.description: Highlight name to match (collection, promotion or teaser name). Matching is case-insensitive.

badgeBackgroundColor.title: Badge background color
badgeBackgroundColor.description: Any valid CSS color. Ex: #ff0000, rgb(255, 0, 0)

badgeTextColor.title: Badge text color
badgeTextColor.description: Any valid CSS color. Ex: #ffffff, rgb(255, 255, 255)
